source_extraction_note: The older parse_source scalar helper drops the *STEAM_PER_EU suffix. Do not use its partial steam input as a rated quantity. This receipt preserves raw source lines/expressions, evaluates the explicitly verified source constant2, and records true litre input.

implementation.structure: Steam4/dynamo3/gas4 original specialized rows. Steam/gas first row appends original localized dense-wall name; gas fourth row orange. Native parent tools builder wand/magnifier/facing wrench once, common harvest/blast/material owner retained.
implementation.energy: Source EnergyStats nominal and half..double range; steam input in actual litres, RU output; dynamo RU input/EU output; gas hides HU fuel input entirely. No energy capacity/recipes/fuel-map row invented.
implementation.efficiency: LH ALL_EU includes RU and HU. Steam uses STEAM_PER_EU2. Source integer truncate: steam/gas6666=66.66%, dynamo7500=75.00%. Steam used-steam(Sides,95%) row follows energy rows.
implementation.identity_and_material: Twelve one-item legacy controller conversions preserve their actual original core CR.REV composition and original source/tool/material/quality metadata. Shared alias map updates lookup and complete enumerations. Original625 named material/667 named harvest lines unchanged; dynamic720storage/120hoppers retained. Full maps1465->1477 materials,1507->1519 harvest. Original265 basic rows preserved.
implementation.known_quantities: Steam controller72U rotor-material+36U hull. Dynamo40U hull. Gas retains existing exact known source composition, including motor/component data; no arbitrary battery/circuit/tag member guessed. Whole multiblock structure is not counted as controller construction.
